title: 1995 INMO
text:
1. In an acute-angled triangle ABC with ∠A = 30◦, H is the orthocenter and M the midpoint of BC. Point T is symmetric to H with respect to M. Show that AT =2BC.

2. Show that there are infinitely many pairs (a,b) of coprime integers such that both the quadratic equations x2 +ax+b= 0 and x2+2ax+b=0 have integer roots.

3. Show that the number of three-element subsets {a,b,c} of {1,2,...,63} with a+b+c < 95 is less than the number of those with a+b+c > 95. 4. Let Γ′ be the circle lying inside a triangle ABC and touching the sides AB and AC and the incircle Γ of the triangle externally. Show that the ratio of the radii of the circles Γ′ and Γ equals tan^2((π−α)/4)

5. The real numbers a1,a2,...,an are all greater than 1 and satisfy |(a)k −(a)k+1| < 1 for 1 ≤ k ≤ n−1. Prove that: (a1/a2) + (a2/a3) + ... + (an/a1) < 2n-1

6. Find all primes p for which [2^(p−1)−1]/p is a perfect square.
